# Vendored dependency

- `three.module.js`: Three.js `r160` (`0.160.0`)
- `OrbitControls.js`: Three.js `r160` example control module
- Source: <https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js>
- License: MIT; the upstream copyright and SPDX header are retained in `three.module.js`, and the full upstream license is included as `three-LICENSE.txt` for both Three.js and OrbitControls.

The file is kept locally so the monitoring workstation can run without a CDN or Internet connection during bench experiments.

`fonts/` contains Inter Latin 400/500/600 WOFF2 files distributed by `@fontsource/inter` 5.2.5, downloaded from `https://unpkg.com/@fontsource/inter@5.2.5/files/`. The SIL Open Font License is retained as `fonts/Inter-LICENSE.txt`. Chinese text uses the operating system's Chinese sans-serif font; all Latin font assets are served locally.
